title: Model 38

description.main: A staple-bound artist's book Christopher Williams made for his 2020 exhibition Footwear (Adapted for Use) at David Zwirner, New York. Walther König published it in Cologne.
description.extended:
Model 38 is a staple-bound artist's book Christopher Williams made for his 2020 exhibition Footwear (Adapted for Use) at David Zwirner, New York.

The exhibition opened on February 27, 2020, at the gallery's 34 East 69th Street space and ran until July 24. It brought together new photographs, wall treatments, hand-painted signs, printed ephemera, sculptures, and videos, drawing on IKEA catalogues, airplane magazines, coloring books, and Williams's own earlier imagery. Among the works were a MODEL sign in enamel paint, glass, aluminum, and felt, and photographs titled Model No. 2745 (Son), Model No. 1542 (Mother), and Model No. 1316 (Father). Walther König published the book in Cologne as a staple-bound pamphlet with a black cover.

Williams was born in Los Angeles in 1956, has been a professor at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf since 2008, and has been represented by David Zwirner since 2000. Footwear (Adapted for Use) was his ninth solo exhibition with the gallery. The Adapted for Use title recurs in later shows, including Kochgeschirr (Adapted for use) at Capitain Petzel, Berlin, and Heimarbeit. Adapted for Use. IKEA Küchen Ensemble. at Galerie Gisela Capitain, Cologne.

notes: Publisher confirmed as König by the DNB record (publisher '[Köln] : [König]', 2020, Broschur); Zwirner and Capitain Petzel name no publisher. DNB title is '[Model] ; Model'; Zwirner and Capitain Petzel title it 'Model 38'. Extent: Zwirner 25 pages; DNB 13 unnumbered leaves. Exhibition end date: the Zwirner exhibition page gives July 24, 2020; Ocula/Artsy/Collector Daily (search snippets, not fetched) give April 18, 2020, likely the original close before COVID closures. Contents of the book itself are not described by any fetched source. Cover: Zwirner image, black with five white staple marks along the spine; matches the Capitain Petzel screenshot.
